newsitem.title: USA: Cluckcorp to buy five restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Cluckcorp to buy five restaurants.

text.p: Cluckcorp International Inc said on Tuesday that it signed a letter of intent to acquire five restaurants in the Pacific northwest and the southeastern United States.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Cluckcorp said it planned to convert the restaurants, if acquired, into its new Harvest Rotisserie home meal replacement concept and sell them to area developer franchisees.
The acquisitions were part of a larger program to buy restaurants to complement Cluckcorp's area development activities, it said. Cluckcorp said it started talks regarding financing the purchases.
